scope: General code fixes and offline replay of previously verified historical materials. No production access, deployment or historical text changes.

validation.skip_reason: D29 real source/translated book fixtures were not supplied.
regression_coverage: Automatic surname mappings cannot suppress known entity ambiguity; case variants are included and findings are not double-counted.
Resolution requires unique confirmed metadata matching the current translation and a known, unambiguous entity.
Longest complete names are not shadowed by ambiguous surnames.
Adjacent pure same-name or confirmed-alias annotations count as one mention; independent prose still counts separately.
Source annotations use the same grouping; original span evidence is preserved.
Target ownership is checked before grouping so another entity cannot claim an annotation span.
A synthetic translation with the new warning reuses its checkpoint without a second model transport call.
validation.isolation: Backend tests use network guards, disabled real dotenv loading and temporary databases/caches. Historical replay additionally prohibits database connections, subprocesses and file writes.

limitations: Only complete adjacent same-entity name/alias annotations are grouped; complex prose and unknown aliases are not guessed.
Confirmed entity resolution uses the existing normalized full source-name identity from character profiles; arbitrary unknown IDs do not clear ambiguity.
These are non-blocking review signals, not proof of omission or a reason to retry translation.
Confirmed alias metadata propagation through the runner and temporal precision classification remain separate follow-up work.
This record does not claim production deployment or paid end-to-end acceptance. CI is checked after pushing the containing commit.
